params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page. Omit for the first page.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort by a supported field. Prefix with `-` for descending order.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter Leads by a partial, case-insensitive person name match.

params.name: email
params.description: Filter by an exact email address.

params.name: created_after
params.description: Return only records created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: created_before
params.description: Return only records created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Return only records updated after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: updated_before
params.description: Return only records updated before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: fields
params.description: Choose which public fields appear in each list record. Omit or pass a blank value for the default list fields, use `*` alone for every public detail field, or pass comma-separated names.

items.docs: Return a paginated list of Leads. Supports filtering by `status` (new, contacted, qualified, unqualified, converted), `source`, `name`, `email`, `company_name`, and created/updated timestamps. Sort supports `created_at` or `-created_at`; pagination uses `limit` and `cursor`. Use `fields` to choose which public Lead fields appear in each record.
Create a new Lead for an unqualified prospect. Leads are kept separate from Accounts and Contacts until explicitly converted via `POST /api/v1/leads/{lead_id}/convert`.

items.docs: Convert a Lead into an Account and Contact, and optionally create a Deal in a single step. You can target an existing Account via `existing_account_id` or let Fixture create a new one from the Lead's `company_name`. On success the Lead is marked `converted` and linked to the newly created records.
